content.short: BuidlGuidl is a DAO serving as the community and incentivization layer around Scaffold-ETH and SpeedRunEthereum.com.
content.description: BuidlGuidl is a decentralized autonomous organization that acts as the community and incentives layer for Scaffold-ETH and SpeedRunEthereum.com. For beginners, Scaffold-ETH provides a practical base to experiment with Solidity, while SpeedRunEthereum.com gamifies the learning path with challenges that test and showcase skills. Developers participate in these challenges together through the BuidlGuidl community, collaborating, sharing solutions, and advancing as they build, test, and ship smart contracts.

resources.title: RAG From the Ground Up
resources.tldr: Builds retrieval-augmented generation from nothing: ingestion, retrieval, generation, and crucially how they evaluated whether it worked. The evaluation half is what most write-ups skip.

resources.title: Building an AI Agent From Scratch
resources.tldr: A minimal assistant written in TypeScript, used to strip agents down to their actual moving parts. Far more instructive than reading about frameworks.

resources.title: Evaluating Agent Skills: Testing Whether They Are Actually Useful
resources.tldr: 92 A/B evaluations run to measure whether agent skills genuinely improved capability. Rare in publishing a measurement rather than an impression.
